name: Raw Material Stockout due to Supplier Failure
description: Simulates a complete disruption in raw material deliveries from a tier-1 supplier, stopping the manufacturing line entirely.

shocks.rationale: Line starved of materials, halting production for a 10x cycle time wait.
Labor overhead continues to burn, driving up unit costs despite zero output.
Constant rescheduling causes sequencing errors on the shop floor.
